name: Kittengumi: El Ladrón de la Sakabato
source:
Kittengumi: The Sakabato Thief is a visual novel that takes us to an alternative Japan (Gapon) where its protagonists, a cat and a panda who thinks he is a cat, will have to find the thief of the sakabato, one of the treasures of the Kittengumi -a group of samurai cats that watches over the security of Nyedo (Edo), to which they belong.

This will be the first official mission of the characters and during this adventure, they will interact with many characters and, depending on the decisions, the story will develop along different paths, not all of them with a happy ending.

The Sakabato Thief is the first of a collection of visual novels that tell different stories starring the members of this group.
translation:
《Kittengumi: The Sakabato Thief》是一部视觉小说，它带我们到另一个日本（Gapon），主角是一只猫和一只自认为是猫的熊猫，他们必须找到Kittengumi的宝藏之一——Sakabato的小偷。Kittengumi是一群武士猫，守护着他们所属的Nyedo（江户）的安全。

这将是角色的第一个正式任务，在这次冒险中，他们将与许多角色互动，并且根据决定，故事将沿着不同的路径发展，并非所有路径都有幸福的结局。

《坂田小偷》是视觉小说集中的第一部，讲述了由该团体成员主演的不同故事。
